answers.feather-effect-name: LiveEffect name: Adobe Fuzzy Mask; radius key: Rad
answers.pucker-effect-name: LiveEffect name: Adobe Pucker & Bloat (Adobe Deform Pucker); amount key: ppvl (percentage)
answers.gaussian-effect-name: LiveEffect name: Adobe PSL Gaussian Blur; radius key: blur (blurValue)
answers.zigzag-effect-keys: LiveEffect name: Adobe Zig Zag Filter; ridges per segment key: ridges
answers.dropshadow-offset-keys: X offset: horz; Y offset: vert; opacity: opac
answers.blocked-menu-cmds: Edit > Check Spelling (Spelling dialog) and Type > Find Font (both dialog loops that cannot be completed from script)
answers.repeat-config-null: Reading radialConfig/gridConfig/symmetryConfig on a Repeat item returns null/undefined (or throws) in 28.0, so they cannot be read or set directly; the skill instead creates the Repeat via executeMenuCommand (e.g. 'Make Radial Repeat' / 'Make Grid Repeat' / 'Make Symmetry Repeat') and sets its options through the Repeat Options dialog handled by the skill's dialog automation (or by preference keys) and reads back the result.
answers.press-quality-bleed: The [Press Quality] preset has zero bleed, so the document bleed is dropped (bleed set to 0) in the exported PDF. To keep it set PDFSaveOptions.bleedLink = true and useDocumentBleeds = true (or set bleedOffsetRect explicitly), applied after setting pDFPreset.
